summary: Verified marketing videos bug fix. Backend list endpoint returns 5 clips ordered by id with url + public_url (gofile.io). All 5 pod-hosted MP4 endpoints respond 200/206 with Content-Type video/mp4 to Range requests. All 5 gofile.io permanent URLs return HTTP 200. Frontend /marketing renders all 5 clip cards with correct data-testids (card, copy, public, download, play), each public link points to the expected gofile.io URL, and the modal player opens with a <video> element when the play overlay is clicked.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds 1600 lines — consider splitting the marketing router into its own module for maintainability.
list_marketing_videos infers orientation from size string prefix '720' — fragile if resolutions change; better to compare width vs height explicitly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_marketing_videos.py -v (13 tests, all passing). Splash can be skipped via sessionStorage.milli_splash_seen='1' (addInitScript). Permanent URLs live in /app/marketing_videos/public_urls.json.
rca of the issue: Original bug: pod-only /api/marketing/videos/*.mp4 URLs 404'd while pod was paused. Fix: uploaded all 5 clips to gofile.io (recorded in /app/marketing_videos/public_urls.json) and extended /api/marketing/videos to include a public_url field surfaced in the UI. Verified end-to-end that both channels return 200.
